reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The regression test opens the draft’s default /entities route rather than Overview, so the required panels never render and its visibility assertions fail.
1 open issue - [Open the Overview tab before checking draft panels](https://github.com/OpenCTI-Platform/opencti/pull/20113#discussion_r4600041674) · New
What changed in this PR Fixes #20102 by allowing the draft overview’s Details and Basic information panels to fill the available content width, matching other entity overviews. **Changes:** - Removes the single-child flex wrapper while preserving configured column widths and spacing. - Adds an E2E regression test for panel widths and same-row alignment, with draft cleanup. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `opencti-platform/​opencti-front/​tests_e2e/​drafts/​draftsList.spec.ts` | Adds draft overview geometry checks and cleanup. | | `opencti-platform/​opencti-front/​src/​private/​components/​drafts/​DraftOverview.tsx` | Removes the wrapper that constrained the overview Grid’s width. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: `openDraft()` only clicks the draft row, whose bare draft URL redirects to `/entities` (`DraftRoot.tsx:254–262`). It does not open `/overview`, so the Details and Basic information panels are never rendered and this regression test fails at the visibility assertions even with the layout fix. Select the Overview tab after opening the draft before locating or measuring the panels.
